question:
Select the option in which the letter-clusters share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of letter-clusters.

AMY : TQA

YJZ : RNB
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77eff343eeeef6975e4e674324b013a0b8a3a630a455e90e53dff0b48dc2b8e8.png] ​

**Logic: Subtraction of 7 from the positional value of the first alphabet and addition of 4 and 2 to the positional value of the second and third alphabet respectively.**

**Given:**

AMY : TQA →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa069f76ea0558fd48e3ad4e497843fe8163c146d495ab0df2d47546b004ed63.png] 

YJZ : RNB →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8688540d0a7264efb02c22d5e8af64ca585c7705382c8fbac1265fd1bf7f16e.png] 

Checking the given options:

**1. **EAT : XFV →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cbc3be572c44f16bb66592705e8e4070e9a2b6e5959b8a796d484134f7487f0.png] 

**2.** TRY : MVW →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9efdbc2396f8eb028568fd3977a0cbf7c5c4a08f34c0fbbe262aea1948f5bdf3.png] 

**3. **PAL : JEN →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe79851478d2364a8beb1ce8eb529ab9de0fff87a8ac58ce00ed7cdf88819c30.png] 

**4. **CUP : VYR →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45d531a7d028b3aadf2ab35e8aa41dc06df920bcfc6de3622ad02834f3e0c1ee.png] 

Here, **'CUP : VYR'** is similar to the given letter clusters.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
